label: reported
text: A resident of Düsseldorf said she heard reports that an emergency was declared on Oct 31 amid Gen Z‑led unrest, and that malls closed early. The newly formed initiative “Gen Z steht auf” has called for demonstrations in 21 German cities over education funding, rising living costs, social services and compulsory military service.

A Calcuttan living in Düsseldorf, Germany, stayed indoors on October 31 after hearing reports of protests and an “emergency” being declared in the city.
Another Calcuttan, who travelled to Paris for an art exhibition, found that the event had been cancelled for its final two days because of protests.
